    # Format the date as YYYY_MM_DD
    date_prefix = created_at_datetime.strftime("%Y_%m_%d")
    
    # Extract directory and filename
    directory, filename = os.path.split(file_path)
    
    # Construct the new file name
    new_filename = f"{date_prefix}-{filename}"
    new_file_path = os.path.join(directory, new_filename)
    
    # Copy the file to the new name
    copy_result = apis.file_system.copy_file(
        access_token=fs_access_token,
        source_file_path=file_path,
        destination_file_path=new_file_path
    )
    print(f"Copied {file_path} to {new_file_path}: {copy_result}")
    
    # Delete the original file
    delete_result = apis.file_system.delete_file(
        access_token=fs_access_token,
        file_path=file_path
    )
    print(f"Deleted original file {file_path}: {delete_result}")
    
    # Check if the file is not from the current year and move it to recycle_bin

        recycle_bin_path = os.path.join('~/recycle_bin/', new_filename)
